text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: XRick is an open-source reimplementation of the classic 1989 action platform game Rick Dangerous. Released in 1998, it recreates the original gameplay while allowing the game to run on modern systems. The project preserves the exploration, trap-filled levels, puzzle solving, and arcade-style platforming of the original while adding improved compatibility across different platforms.
